capabilities: Detect a language prefix in inline code
Apply syntax highlighting to inline code spans
disambiguation: Only affects inline code spans, not fenced code blocks, which Obsidian already highlights.
extras: README is only two lines; usage details are left to an external example/documentation.
problem: Obsidian highlights syntax only in fenced code blocks, not in inline code within a sentence.
summary: Syntax highlighter that renders inline code blocks with language colors when the code is prefixed with a language name like '<lang>'.
